description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'TransistorTest' which tests the behavior of the 'Transistor' class in various activation and limiting scenarios within an Akka Streams context. It sets up parameterized tests to evaluate different inlet/outlet activation orders and element limiting conditions, ensuring the 'Transistor' graph stage handles stream interactions correctly.

classes.name: TransistorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the Transistor class with various stream activation scenarios.

methods.name: parameters
methods.description: Provides all combinations of inlet/outlet activation orders and element limiting agents for parameterized testing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem, test publishers, test sink, and the Transistor graph before each test.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests complete.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Runs the core test logic, pushing and requesting elements according to different orders and limits, then verifies correct operation.

methods.name: isNotLimiting
methods.description: Helper method to check if a terminal is not acting as the limiting factor in the test.

methods.name: permutations
methods.description: Generates all permutations of a list of elements for testing different activation sequences.

methods.name: permutations (int n)
methods.description: Generates permutations of integers from 0 to n-1.
